status_note: The phi(X,f(X)) lane-trim chain projections (lazy Varnode cover rebuild via setHighLevel, the X x f(X) interval intersection in the cond block, trimOpInput COPY placement at each MULTIEQUAL lane's incoming-block end, trimOpOutput, phi lane rewiring, and markInternalCopies non-printing flags) are byte-identical MATCH over both cases. Residual: the final forced-merge convergence (Ghidra throws LowlevelError on this synthetic input; Rugra skips the failed merge) is a known deliberate non-projection; and the full-pipeline ActionConditionalExe stage is covered by the curl corpus gates, not by this fixture.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: HighVariable::updateInternalCover (variable.cc:324-335) reads inst[i]->getCover() which lazily rebuilds (varnode.hh:202 -> varnode.cc:233 updateCover -> cover->rebuild). Merge::mergeOp (merge.cc:719-772) mutates the MULTIEQUAL's inputs via trimOpInput; trimOpInput (merge.cc:692-712) returns void, creating a COPY op (allocateCopyTrim, merge.cc:411-434) whose output replaces the lane input (opSetInput) and which is inserted at opInsertEnd(copyop, op->getParent()->getIn(slot)) for MULTIEQUAL.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: updateInternalCover iterates instances in insertion order gated on inst[0]->hasCover() (variable.cc:329). mergeOp phase 1 walks inputs i=0..max checking mergeTestRequired against high_out and against every earlier input j<i (merge.cc:730-741); phase 2 walks inputs left-to-right and breaks at the first cover-test failure (merge.cc:744-745); the trim loop starts nexttrim=0 and increments only while the retest still fails (merge.cc:748-758).
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: No counters; the Varnode COVERDIRTY flag is set by calcCover and cleared by updateCover's rebuild (varnode.cc:233-241); copyTrims accumulates one entry per allocateCopyTrim (merge.cc:432) and is consumed by processCopyTrims (merge.cc:1425-1444).
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: CoverBlock::intersect (cover.cc) compares uindex ranges of both endpoints: 0 no intersection, 1 boundary touch, 2 interval; mergeTest/HighIntersectTest count only >1 (variable.cc:1152/973). MULTIEQUAL ops order at the very block beginning (getUIndex maps markers to 0).

overlays.policy: primary file under test; hash-verify before replacing the pinned base copy

rugra_source.archive_policy: Immutable explicit dependency closure plus one hash-verified source overlay; unrelated worktree files are excluded

analysis_options.funcdata: One synthetic Funcdata per case (T1 CMOV shape with f(X) in the cond block; T2 control with f(X) in the then block); 5-block CFG b0..b4; no followFlow; ActionAssignHigh + ActionMergeRequired + ActionCopyMarker driven directly
analysis_options.case_matrix: T1: phi(X,fX) with INT_RIGHT in cond block b1 (X live through b1, fX defined mid-b1) - interval intersection forces trimOpInput COPYs at end of b1 (reads X) and end of b2 (reads fX) plus trimOpOutput COPY at b3; T2: same shape with INT_RIGHT moved into then block b2
analysis_options.error_injection: none (Ghidra LowlevelError from the synthetic final forced merge is caught and not part of the projection; Rugra's mergeOp phase-3 skip-on-failure yields the same observable IR)
analysis_options.normalization: Block creation ordinals (bN) and fixture varnode names (X/fX/phiout/y) replace raw pointers; trim-COPY lanes print copy@<block>(<reads>)

observation_schema.format: fixed-order pipe-delimited UTF-8 records (covers, intersect chars, per-block op lists, phi lanes, per-COPY non-printing flags) with final newline
observation_schema.cover_projection: nonempty=1 for every named varnode pins the lazy rebuild (a Rugra build that reads inst.cover without update_cover_locked emits nonempty=0 and diverges)
observation_schema.intersect_projection: char=2 for X_fX (interval in the cond block) and char=1 for X_phiout/fX_phiout (boundary tip at the join) reproduce CoverBlock::intersect 0/1/2 semantics
observation_schema.preserved: No block ordinal, op order, opcode name, or boolean is normalized; only raw pointers are replaced by creation ordinals and fixture names

build.oracle_archive: Exact locked Ghidra commit archive and locked Makefile libdecomp.a
build.access_leverage: public API only (setHighLevel/getMerge/mergeAddrTied/mergeMarker/markInternalCopies/getCover); the #define private public / #define class struct header-include block follows tests/oracle/condexe_pullback_1204.cc precedent
build.rust_build: Cargo --locked --offline in isolated target, then rustc with the built librugra rlib

lazy_cover_rebuild.covers: cover|nonempty=1 for X/fX/phiout after setHighLevel (funcdata_varnode.cc:595 -> assignHigh -> getCover chain); pins RULE-PROPCOPY-ADDRTIED-0001's root cause (Rugra pre-fix emitted nonempty=0)

lane_intersect_character.covers: intersect char: X_fX=2 (interval, cond block), X_phiout=1 / fX_phiout=1 (boundary tip at the join) — CoverBlock::intersect 0/1/2 (cover.cc) and the getUIndex MULTIEQUAL-at-begin ordering

trim_copy_placement.covers: ops b1 gains COPY(X) before the CBRANCH, b2 gains COPY(fX) at block end (the branch-local instantiation), b3 gains the trimOpOutput COPY(phiout); phi lanes rewire to copy@b1(X) / copy@b2(fX) (merge.cc:692-712 + 656-682)

internal_copy_marking.covers: np flags of every COPY after markInternalCopies (merge.cc:1449-1532): all print 0 here because the synthetic final forced merge throws before the highs unify — the flag channel itself is compared byte-for-byte

forced_merge_convergence.covers: On this synthetic input Ghidra's mergeOp throws LowlevelError at the final forced merge while Rugra's phase 3 skips the failed merge; both leave the same observable IR, but the exception channel difference is deliberately not projected (changing Rugra's merge_op phase-3 to abort would alter pipeline-visible behavior and needs its own task)

branches.detail: Ghidra mergeOp throws LowlevelError 'Unable to force merge' (merge.cc:767-769) aborting the whole decompile; Rugra's merge_op phase 3 skips failed merges and continues (src/merge.rs merge_op). Aligning the abort channel (or proving the corpus never reaches it) needs a dedicated task with pipeline-level differential evidence.
